{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABWEOsaw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6Pzg_nGzs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 39, "title": "Complete PMX before/after-physics deformation layers and bone/rigid-body synchronization", "body": "## Goal

Complete the **PMX before-/after-physics deformation-layer pipeline** in `three-mmd-loader`. Fix the remaining explicitly documented limitations from [Grant Issue #37](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/37) / [PR #38](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/38), particularly **after-physics kinematic-body/grant disagreement** and **dynamic-body targets currently skipping after-physics grants**. Integrate authored VMD/VPD pose, direct/group bone morphs, grants, IK, Bullet/Ammo body modes, post-physics bone processing, and final skinning without double application.

The existing `main` already processes before-physics and after-physics transforms, but does **not** stage authored transforms independently per layer. The precise failures and a real Ammo reproducer are documented in [docs/grants.md](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/grants.md), with assertions in `tests/grant.test.ts`. Preserve these reproducers, then turn them into passing positive behavior tests as appropriate.

## Real MMD model candidates — for optional local/private validation

**Primary: 「大葉式テイ様改変 天月りよん」 by 水道屋 (Suidouya / 無限に手設定).**

- **Creator's own technical explanation:** https://unlimitedboneworks.blogspot.com/2025/02/blog-post_16.html — explicitly states the distributed Riyon model uses **after-physics processing on the cape and hair**; explains the motion/IK → physics → post-physics bone/grant ordering.
- **Original creator distribution:** https://bowlroll.net/file/128773
- **Original distribution video / access instructions:** https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm30627162 — its description indicates an eight-digit password shown at the end of the video and version/correction notes.

This is the first candidate because the creator explicitly confirms using the exact feature. **The PMX bytes and license have NOT been inspected**, so the actual `flag & 0x1000` bone count, links to physical rigid bodies, and coverage of the *specific* inherited kinematic/dynamic target failures must be verified after legitimate local acquisition. Do not infer that all edge cases exist in this real model. If the model lacks the needed target/body combination, the private inspector must say so; automated synthetic fixtures must still cover it.

**Secondary (modified local copy only if allowed): PAC 「時計塔」** — original demonstration https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm17234819; technical explanation https://mikudan.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-351.html. It documents setting the `1番車真親` bone to **after-physics** + **local grant** to follow a simulated parent. **The distributed unmodified PMX is not confirmed to contain those flags**. Modifications, if permitted by its original license, must remain private and be documented exactly; never redistribute a modified copy.

A third model may be chosen if these prove unavailable/inappropriate. Candidate sources are references, not prevalidated test fixtures. Any password or license review remains a maintainer-only optional activity, never an automated acceptance dependency.

## Functional implementation requirements

1. **Explicit layered pose state.** Preserve independent immutable/rest and per-frame authored bone pose (VMD/VPD and morph), before-physics procedural result, physics body result, and after-physics authored/procedural layers. Keep motion/morph data from being inadvertently baked into a different layer or applied twice. Refactor existing `MMDAnimationHelper` / `MMDPhysics` orchestration as needed; avoid overwriting dynamic physics state with authored motion or discarding legitimate post-physics effects.
2. **Correct order and evaluation.** Respect PMX bone `flag & 0x1000`, `transformationClass`, file index, parent-child dependencies, grants/IK, pre/post-phase ordering, PMX bone morph offsets and animated VMD bone keys. Process post-physics authored motion and grants/IK in the correct phase, not simply rerender a single global pose twice. Preserve the PMXEditor and MMD compatibility choices already recorded in `docs/grants.md` and identify any genuine mismatch against the format/reference.
3. **Rigid body semantics / consistency.** Handle kinematic (PMX mode 0), dynamic (mode 1), and dynamic-with-position-alignment (mode 2) correctly when their controlling bones are in either phase. Fix the existing post-phase **kinematic target mismatch**, ensuring correct simulation-time vs after-step vs next-step body/bone poses for contacts and constraints. Do **not** claim a body participated in an already-completed physics step at a later post-physics pose. If accurate behavior needs staged substeps, deferred kinematic synchronization or another explicit model, implement and test the actual semantics rather than copying the final bone transform back and calling it solved.
4. **Post-phase grants on dynamic targets.** Remove the blanket skip only when a defined layer composition policy produces correct results. Honor Bullet authority for dynamic bodies while retaining the legal after-physics authored/grant/IK contributions in final bone output and any relevant next-step inputs. Demonstrate with executable tests that both rendered bones and physical body trajectories obey the selected MMD-compatible ordering, without teleportation or double application.
5. **Both helper modes and all physics workflows.** Standard helper, `pmxAnimation: true`, `sharedPhysics` (multiple meshes), and nonshared physics must remain correct, including initialization/warmup, physics reset, enabling/disabling physics/IK/grant/animation/boneMorph, pause, seek, loop, helper transfer, pose reset, time step 0, nonzero delta and repeated updates. PMD behavior must remain unaffected.
6. **Safe invalid input.** Cyclic/missing grants and parents, invalid or nonfinite ratios/poses and impossible dependencies must not hang or poison unrelated bones; diagnostics may explicitly identify invalid PMX metadata. No broad refactoring of unrelated feature families without regression coverage.
7. **Observable output.** Final animation layers must feed skinned vertices, SDEF positions/normals, toon/outline/shadow passes and relevant rigid-body follow-up. Do not require custom shader language or drop WebGL2/WebGPU parity.
8. **Scope limits.** PMX external-parent-key animation, PMX 2.1 impulse/flip morphs, unrelated VMD light/shadow sections, animated nonuniform bone scale and unrelated material/UV features are separate concerns unless directly needed. If a specifically requested deformation-layer scenario fundamentally cannot be matched, document the precise counterexample with an automated reproducible test and open a narrowly scoped follow-up instead of claiming "fully supported".

## Private local model/physics viewer

Extend the existing loopback-only `npm run dev:sdef` local viewer (or provide an equally safe `npm run dev:physics-layers` entry) without changing public examples:

- Add `physics-layers/` private model source under Git-ignored `examples/assets/private/physics-layers/`. Serve legitimately obtained PMX/VMD/textures **only** from the loopback server. Check actual creator/modified model README and distribution terms before local use; never acquire automatically, upload, commit, include in npm, upload Actions artifacts, deploy to Pages or publish example screenshots.
- List actual model bone names/indices, `flag & 0x1000` (pre/post), transformation classes, grant sources/ratios/flags, IK links, rigid body mode and mapping, and count per category, including **post-phase kinematic and dynamic targets**. Clearly report when the PMX lacks a needed case.
- Use actual `MMDLoader`, `MMDAnimationHelper` and **Ammo simulation enabled**. Provide physics on/off, step/pause/reset, reproducible motion/pose control, and a before-physics vs post-physics bone/body transform diagnostic. Where feasible offer an optional trusted MMD comparison and note limitations (different physics engine time steps and solver behavior).
- Include an internally generated PMX/Ammo fixture that exercises the formerly failing cases, so a fresh checkout demonstrates the viewer and CI without any third-party files or credentials.
- Keep existing SDEF / bone / group / material / UV / Grant private views working; preserve all public example assets, manifest, screenshots and URLs unchanged. License review/public model replacement is a separate decision.

## Fully automated **pre-merge** acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generate PMX fixture(s) through the released `mmd-parser ^1.1.4` and real loader with nontrivial before-/after-physics class order, authored VMD tracks, bone morphs, IK/grants, parent transforms, and kinematic/dynamic/mode-2 bodies plus a constrained pair; assert flags and metadata from parser to runtime.
- [ ] Replace the existing reproducible after-physics kinematic-target limitation with **passing assertions for explicitly documented step/phase semantics**, checking simulation contacts/constraints, kinematic body snapshots, final rendered bone pose and next-step input. No cosmetic post-step body teleport counted as a physics fix.
- [ ] Cover previously skipped after-physics grants/IK on dynamic-body targets with a physically meaningful policy, independently checked expected values for dynamic world/body pose and final skeletal pose; prove no authored/grant offset is lost or reapplied.
- [ ] Compare each intermediate phase against a separate, mathematically independent CPU pose reference: rest/authored/morph, before-physics grants+IK, actual Ammo output, post-physics authored+grants+IK, final mesh. Do not reproduce production formulas as the only oracle.
- [ ] Real Ammo tests with deterministic fixed time step/seeded initial state, contacts and at least one constraint; assert both bone and body transformations **across multiple frames**, not just one `update(0)` or a mocked physics call. Give numerical tolerances and bound numerical drift.
- [ ] Both helper modes and shared/nonshared physics, pause/seek/loop/zero updates/reset/warmup, feature toggles and helper transfers produce no pose accumulation, divergent ordering or state corruption; PMD, vertex/bone/group/material/UV morph, normal grant, SDEF and ordinary physical-body regression suites still pass.
- [ ] Browser tests on **mandatory WebGL2** and native WebGPU when available verify real skinned positions/normals and surface/outline/shadow output against expected final post-physics deformations. GPU compilation alone is not sufficient.
- [ ] Private viewer shows real PMX layer and rigid-body flags, step-by-step source/body/target transforms and generated-fixture failures/resolution; absent real candidate model **never fails CI**.
- [ ] Tests prove private assets/viewer are excluded from `npm pack`, `npm run build:examples`, public Pages/build manifests and Actions artifacts. The private server remains loopback-only and rejects paths, symlinks and disallowed extensions.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `MMD_EXAMPLE_FIXTURES=1 npm run build:examples`, `npm run test:examples` and isolated npm JS/TS package consumers pass **before** the PR is merged.
- [ ] No human visual approval, password-based download, third-party asset acquisition, npm release or post-merge deployment check is required for automated implementation completion.

## Required post-merge verification

**None** for this implementation Issue/PR. Private real-model visual comparison is optional. The existing [#30](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/30) remains a separate deferred check and must not be closed automatically.

- [PMXEditor specification / deformation layer ordering](https://gist.github.com/FlandreDaisuki/90ae5abf3138a15994526b6bfec73c2c)
- [Creator's concrete Riyon after-physics usage](https://unlimitedboneworks.blogspot.com/2025/02/blog-post_16.html)
